source: This is an important progression in the family: FA1 asks “How do we avoid ZXNAME0000XZ traffic?”, FA2 asks “How do we partition the work better?”, and FA3 asks “How do we overlap distinct execution resources on Hopper?”
zh: 这是该系列中的一个重要进展：FA1 询问“我们如何避免 ZXNAME0000XZ 流量？”，FA2 询问“我们如何更好地划分工作？”，FA3 询问“我们如何在 Hopper 上重叠不同的执行资源？”
